title: B2C Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
About the job

🚀 WE’RE HIRING / ESTAMOS CONTRATANDO

B2C Growth Marketing Specialist / Especialista en Growth Marketing B2C

📍 Mérida, Yucatán, México

💼 Full-time | Hybrid / Tiempo completo | Híbrido




🇺🇸 ENGLISH

EducUp is looking for a B2C Growth Marketing Specialist to help us scale student acquisition across our professional education products in the U.S.

We’re looking for someone who can lead B2C growth strategies, acquire users efficiently, improve conversion funnels, and turn marketing investment into measurable revenue growth.




What you’ll work on:

• Lead and execute B2C growth and customer acquisition strategies

• Manage and optimize Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid acquisition channels

• Improve CAC, conversion rates, ROAS, and overall funnel performance

• Build and optimize landing pages, offers, promotions, and acquisition funnels

• Test audiences, creatives, messaging, pricing, and promotional strategies

• Develop retargeting and lifecycle marketing campaigns

• Support email marketing, SEO, content, and organic acquisition initiatives

• Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve activation and conversion

• Work closely with Product, Content, Sales, and Leadership

• Identify scalable opportunities to grow enrollments and revenue




What we’re looking for:

• Experience in B2C growth, performance marketing, user acquisition, or digital marketing

• Strong experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads

• Solid understanding of funnels, conversion optimization, CAC, ROAS, and retention

• Analytical and highly results-oriented mindset

• Comfortable testing, iterating, and moving fast

• Proactive, resourceful, and able to work independently

• Good English communication skills

• Based in Mérida, Yucatán, or available to work from Mérida

• Experience in EdTech, e-learning, subscriptions, marketplaces, or consumer apps is a plus




💰 Competitive base compensation + performance incentives based on experience.

If you’re interested, send us your CV along with a short introduction and examples of campaigns, acquisition results, ROAS improvements, or measurable growth you’ve achieved.




🇲🇽 ESPAÑOL

EducUp está buscando un Especialista en Growth Marketing B2C que nos ayude a escalar la adquisición de estudiantes para nuestros productos de educación profesional en Estados Unidos.

Buscamos una persona capaz de liderar estrategias de crecimiento B2C, adquirir usuarios eficientemente, mejorar nuestros funnels de conversión y convertir la inversión en marketing en crecimiento medible de ingresos.




Responsabilidades:

• Liderar y ejecutar estrategias de growth y adquisición B2C

• Gestionar y optimizar Google Ads, Meta Ads y otros canales de adquisición pagada

• Mejorar CAC, tasa de conversión, ROAS y rendimiento general del funnel

• Crear y optimizar landing pages, ofertas, promociones y funnels de adquisición

• Probar audiencias, creativos, mensajes, precios y estrategias promocionales

• Desarrollar campañas de retargeting y lifecycle marketing

• Apoyar iniciativas de email marketing, SEO, contenido y adquisición orgánica

• Analizar el comportamiento de los usuarios e identificar oportunidades de mejora

• Trabajar directamente con Product, Content, Sales y Leadership

• Identificar oportunidades escalables para aumentar matrículas e ingresos




Lo que buscamos:

• Experiencia en B2C growth, performance marketing, adquisición de usuarios o marketing digital

• Experiencia sólida con Google Ads y Meta Ads

• Buen dominio de funnels, optimización de conversión, CAC, ROAS y retención

• Mentalidad analítica y orientada a resultados

• Capacidad para experimentar, iterar y moverse rápido

• Persona proactiva, resolutiva e independiente

• Buen nivel de inglés

• Residencia en Mérida, Yucatán, o disponibilidad para trabajar desde Mérida

• Experiencia en EdTech, e-learning, suscripciones, marketplaces o apps de consumo es un plus




💰 Compensación base competitiva + incentivos por desempeño según experiencia.

Si te interesa, envíanos tu CV junto con una breve presentación y ejemplos de campañas, mejoras de ROAS, resultados de adquisición o crecimiento medible que hayas logrado.




🚀 Join EducUp and help us scale the next generation of professional education. / Únete a EducUp y ayúdanos a escalar la próxima generación de educación profesional.

description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern who is best-in-class, with a high IQ and EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team. Our Marketing Growth team runs consumer programs that reach millions of shoppers promoting subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle campaigns across email, push, RCS/SMS, in-app messages, and landing pages.

This role sits where marketing meets data, engineering and product. As a Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern, you will play a critical role in measuring and improving the programs that drive our consumer business. A core focus will be writing the queries and building the reporting that tell us whether a program worked, and designing the tests that answer the questions we would otherwise be guessing at. In addition to analysis, you will work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into clear requirements and to identify what we would need built to make new programs possible. This role is well-suited to someone with a technical background who is drawn to the business and product side of the work and who wants exposure to how marketing decisions are made.

What You'll Do:

Answer questions with data


Write your own SQL to pull campaign, cohort, and subscription performance.
Track the metrics that drive the business: DAU, NTM, LTV, CAC
Analyze performance across time periods and segments, and preemptively flag concerns or areas for improvement 
Own the dashboards behind our decisions, and use AI to find the answers hiding in them


Design and measure experiments


Design A/B test variants across all channels and audience splits. Identify success metrics for any test or campaign prior to launch based on key business priorities
Write the post-test analysis: what worked, what didn't, what we do differently next time
Own consumer surveys from request to results: define and query the audience, launch, monitor completion, report back what we learned, and optimize the process


Bridge marketing and engineering


Translate marketing needs into specs and tickets an engineer can act on 
Investigate system alerts and concerns by tracing any issue through dashboards and logs back to its source
QA new product features, software, and placements, and recommend how marketing should utilize them
Identify underused channels and product placements, and propose how marketing could leverage them


Automate And Improve How We Work


Leverage AI tools (Claude and similar) within your own work. Think recurring reports, first-pass analyses, monitoring performance, and triage. Build automations and templates the rest of the team can use
Own recurring operational queues and look for the patterns and fixes behind repeat problems instead of just clearing them


What We Look For:

Skills & Competencies


Basic working knowledge of SQL.
Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or HTML/CSS, and enough comfort reading code. 
More interested in the business and product side than in engineering for its own sake. You want to know why the number moved, not only how the system works
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, summaries, first-pass analyses — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle
Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds
A strong bias for action


Educational & Professional Experience


Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in engineering, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related technical field
Exposure to BI tools (Redash/SIA, Looker, Tableau, or similar) is a plus
Prior experience with a CRM platform like Braze is a plus
Any experience with product management, experiment design, or A/B testing is a plus


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

About the job

About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About The Role

Happyrobot is looking for a highly organized and execution-driven Field Marketing Specialist to join our rapidly growing LATAM Field Marketing team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning and executing our LATAM conference strategy and initiatives that connect directly with customers and prospects to drive pipeline.

This role will largely be focused on third-party industry trade shows and conferences in LatAm, mainly in Brazil and Mexico. As we build out a robust field marketing engine, you will collaborate with our events team and work closely with our Content and Creative team to ensure our booth experiences and event collateral are top-tier.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love the logistics of a great event, we want to hear from you!

What You’ll Do


Manage all trade show and conference deadlines, coordinate booth materials, and oversee shipping/freight logistics.
Organize, prep, and manage on-site schedules for the sales team and attending executives to maximize their time and impact.
Research, evaluate, and recommend the best industry conferences and trade shows across our target verticals.
Secure, handle, and optimize event sponsorships and executive presentation/speaking opportunities.
Ensure seamless lead capture at events and partner with revenue teams to track pipeline impact.


Must Have


Minimum of 2 years of dedicated field marketing and event management expertise.
Hands-on experience working with major trade show vendors and general contractors.
Strong experience using Salesforce for lead capture, list imports, and campaign tracking.
Basic ability to navigate Figma to collaborate efficiently with our creative and design teams on booth graphics and collateral.
Ability to hit the ground running immediately and handle high event volumes.


Nice-to-have


English, Spanish & Portuguese languages Proficiency. 


Why join us?


Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.


Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Communications Intern who is best in class with a high IQ and EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team.

As a Marketing Growth Communications Intern, you will play a critical support role with responsibility for preparing and executing the campaigns behind our consumer programs — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle communications — that reach millions of shoppers. A core focus will be managing our CRM platform (Braze) across email, push, RCS/SMS, and in-app messages, building and QAing assets, managing compliance approvals, and reporting on performance. In addition to execution, you will help build content to support channel optimization, segmentation, and analytics across all channels. To achieve these goals, you will engage with varying members across the marketing department, as well as Design, Product and Compliance.

The primary aim for this role is to help create relevant, customized and personalized content for our Sezzle consumers, to maximize revenue and engagement. Beyond executing campaigns, you'll be encouraged to help shape them — proposing the audience, the timing, and the message.

What You'll Do:

Build and launch campaigns


Build marketing communications in our CRM platform (Braze) across email, push, RCS/SMS, and in-app messages
Build and QA landing pages and campaign assets, making sure everything renders correctly before it reaches a single shopper
Own the day-to-day asset production flow: build, quality assurance, approvals, deployment, and communication with internal and external stakeholders
Manage the compliance and legal approval of assets.


Keep the operation running


Support day-to-day operations, keeping every marketing initiative up to date and on schedule
Maintain and organize campaign documentation — briefs, schedules, reports, and final assets
Identify potential risks early and come with a recommendation for how to mitigate them
Support the client and sales teams with in-app promotional setup and reporting


Measure and improve


Pull campaign performance data and report back on what actually happened
Recommend how to optimize the next campaign based on what the last one showed
Test copy, creative, and timing, and help work out which version earns its place
Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to speed up research, first drafts, and reporting


What We Look For:

Skills & Competencies


Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English 
Attention to detail is a must. There are plenty of moving parts within this role
Experience copywriting short and engaging messages
Comfortable with numbers — you can look at a table of campaign results and say something useful about it
Basic creative design skills and knowledge of Figma
You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, copy, summaries — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle
Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds
A strong bias for action


Educational & Professional Experience


Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in marketing, communications, advertising, business, or a related field
Basic project management skills
Prior experience with Braze or another CRM/marketing automation platform is a plus
Experience building email templates or landing pages is a plus
Any experience with email, push notifications, in-app messaging, eCommerce, or digital marketing is a plus
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Marketing and Communications Intern is $800 USD monthly gross.

About the job

About Kueski

At Kueski, we're dedicated to improving the financial lives of people in Mexico. Since 2012, we've been the leading buy now, pay later (BNPL) and online consumer credit platform in Latin America, known for our innovative financial services. Our flagship product, Kueski Pay, provides seamless payment solutions for both online and in-store transactions, establishing itself as the preferred option for nearly 30% of Mexico's top e-commerce merchants. Notably, we were the first to introduce BNPL on Amazon Mexico.

We're a tech company with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration, and impact, fostering a strong, diverse, and inclusive workplace. Our commitment to excellence and ethical business practices has earned us multiple industry recognitions. In 2024, we were named one of the World’s Top FinTech Companies by CNBC and recognized as one of the most ethical companies in Mexico by AMITAI. Additionally, we were certified as a Best Place to Work for LGBTQ+ Equality by HRC Equidad MX 2025 and ranked among the Best Companies for Female Talent by EFY.

Position

The Growth Team Lead is the owner of Kueski’s active customer growth across Kueski Pay and Kueski Cash. This role pairs senior product leadership with commercial ownership to set and commit to active customer targets and chair a standing cross-functional growth team spanning Lending, Marketing, Branding, CX, Data, Account Management, and Credit Risk.

The Growth Team Lead resolves trade-offs across these functions, prioritizes the growth levers that matter most, and builds the foundational infrastructure — lifecycle marketing, attribution, shared metrics — that determines whether every other growth initiative can succeed.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Commercial Ownership


Own the P&L outcome for Kueski’s active customer growth and report progress against targets to executive leadership.
Set and commit to active customer growth targets, then translate those targets into pillar-level goals owned by named cross-functional leads; paired with leading indicators the team can move within an experiment window.
Prioritize the core growth pillars, including pricing and acceptance, activation, repeat usage and habit formation, churn prediction, and reactivation.


Cross-Functional Growth Leadership


Resolve trade-offs between competing functional goals, such as portfolio growth versus customer or merchant experience.
Lead the cross-functional Growth Team spanning Lending, Marketing, Branding, CX, Data, Account Management, and Risk, driving weekly pillar stand-ups and monthly growth reviews.
Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data to scope and sequence foundational and short-term growth product work, including activation, engagement, and retention features.


Experimentation & Growth Measurement


Direct the fix of foundational growth infrastructure — lifecycle marketing enablement, attribution, and the shared growth dashboard — as a prerequisite for reliable retention and lifecycle programs.


Executive Communication & Strategic Alignment


Build narratives that align cross-functional partners around growth strategy, progress, and results, and represent growth priorities in quarterly leadership reviews.


Experience


7+ years in product management, including ownership of cross-functional or multi-product initiatives at scale.
Proven track record owning a growth or lifecycle P&L, or equivalent commercial accountability, ideally in consumer fintech, or consumer lending business.
Experience leading a cross-functional team and resolving trade-offs among stakeholders with competing goals.
Working knowledge of lifecycle marketing and growth infrastructure (e.g., an ESP/CDP such as Braze, attribution, CMS).

description:
About the job

Software Engineer




En Adok estamos construyendo software con IA para abogados y notarios en México.




Somos un equipo pequeño y técnico que trabaja en un producto que combina aplicaciones web modernas, inteligencia artificial, automatización y procesos legales complejos. Buscamos a alguien con ganas de aprender, construir y crecer como ingeniero.




El trabajo se desarrolla en un ambiente rápido y técnico, donde los problemas no siempre vienen completamente definidos y es importante poder entender el contexto, hacer buenas preguntas, proponer soluciones y aprender sobre la marcha.




¿Qué vas a hacer?




Vas a trabajar en diferentes partes de nuestro producto, incluyendo:




Construcción de funcionalidades con React, TypeScript y Next.js.

Desarrollo de APIs y servicios backend.

Trabajo con bases de datos y diseño de modelos de datos.

Integraciones y automatizaciones.

Desarrollo de funcionalidades que utilizan IA y LLMs.

Trabajo con infraestructura y servicios en la nube.

Investigación y resolución de problemas técnicos.

Llevar funcionalidades desde una idea hasta producción.

Mantener y mejorar código existente.




No esperamos que llegues sabiendo todo. Sí esperamos que sepas aprender y resolver cosas por tu cuenta.




¿Qué buscamos?




Entre 0 y 5 años de experiencia profesional desarrollando software.
Experiencia construyendo aplicaciones web con tecnologías modernas.
Buen manejo de TypeScript / JavaScript.
Experiencia con React o algún framework frontend moderno.
Conocimientos básicos de bases de datos y modelado de datos.
Conocimientos básicos de conceptos de backend y cloud.
Capacidad para entender rápidamente un código existente y trabajar sobre él.
Que puedas trabajar bien en un ambiente rápido y con cierto grado de ambigüedad.
Buen criterio para resolver problemas y atención al detalle.
Muchas ganas de aprender y crecer como ingeniero.
IA como herramienta, no como reemplazo.




En Adok usamos IA intensivamente para desarrollar software y esperamos que tú también lo hagas.




Herramientas como Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT y similares son parte de nuestro día a día.




Pero no buscamos a alguien que simplemente copie lo que genera la IA.




Queremos que puedas entender el código que estás entregando, cuestionar las soluciones que propone la IA y explicar por qué tomaste una determinada decisión técnica.




Para nosotros, la IA debe hacerte un ingeniero mucho más productivo, no reemplazar tu criterio como ingeniero.




Sería un plus:




Experiencia con Next.js.
Experiencia con Node.js.
Experiencia con MongoDB u otra base de datos.
Experiencia con AWS, Vercel u otra plataforma de cloud.
Haber construido funcionalidades con IA/LLMs.
Haber trabajado en una startup o equipo pequeño.
Proyectos personales, open source o cualquier cosa que hayas construido por tu cuenta.

skills: Partner with engineering and product teams to understand business workflows, system architecture, integrations, and technical dependencies. Independently identify quality risks and define an appropriate testing and automation strategy.

Architect Scalable Automation Solutions. Design, develop, maintain, and continuously improve reliable automation frameworks and reusable test utilities for modern web applications, APIs, backend services, and integrated systems using technologies such as Playwright, TypeScript, and Python.
Build the appropriate balance of API, integration, component, contract, data, and end-to-end automation, minimizing unnecessary dependence on UI-level testing.

Participate in discovery, requirements refinement, technical design, and architecture discussions to identify edge cases, dependencies, testability concerns, and potential failure scenarios before development is complete.

Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish effective quality gates. Optimize execution through parallelization, tagging, test selection, environment management, reporting, and failure diagnostics.

Design robust API and integration validation for RESTful services and backend workflows, including request/response validation, authentication, error handling, service dependencies, and asynchronous processes.

Validate data across databases, APIs, files, and integrated systems using SQL and programmatic approaches. Verify data integrity, transformations, reconciliation, and complex backend processing when required.

Investigate failures using application logs, browser developer tools, network traces, API clients, database queries, and application telemetry. Distinguish between product defects, automation failures, test-data issues, infrastructure problems, and environment instability.

Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate test design, coding, debugging, documentation, and analysis while critically reviewing generated solutions and maintaining engineering standards.

5+ years of experience in an SDET, Software Engineer, Quality Engineer, Test Automation Engineer, or comparable engineering role, with experience delivering quality solutions for modern web applications, APIs, and integrated systems.

Strong software-development skills in at least one modern programming language. TypeScript/JavaScript or Python is strongly preferred. You should be comfortable designing maintainable software, working with existing codebases, debugging applications, and applying software-engineering principles rather than simply writing test scripts.

Ability to independently own quality engineering activities for a project or significant product area, proactively identifying problems and driving them to resolution without requiring detailed testing instructions.

Ability to clearly communicate technical risks, constructively challenge assumptions, collaborate across technical and non-technical teams, and influence engineering decisions related to quality and testability.
Strong experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks for web applications and APIs. Hands-on experience with Playwright is strongly preferred.

Strong understanding of testing at different layers, including unit, component, API, integration, contract, data, and end-to-end testing, with the ability to determine which testing approach provides the most value for a given risk.

Strong experience testing REST APIs, JSON payloads, service integrations, backend workflows, and databases. Proficiency with SQL and experience validating data across integrated systems is highly valued.

Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent, with an understanding of automated quality gates and continuous delivery practices.
Strong working knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, coding standards, and collaborative software-development practices.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to take ambiguous requirements or complex system designs and independently identify risks, edge cases, failure scenarios, dependencies, and appropriate validation approaches.

Strong analytical capabilities. description:
About the job

Descripción del Puesto




¿Te apasiona diseñar arquitecturas de datos e integración de alto impacto para ecosistemas financieros complejos?

Buscamos un/a Data & Integration Architecture Lead que lidere la definición de la arquitectura de datos y los modelos de integración de una nueva área bancaria, estableciendo cómo se estructuran, gobiernan, integran y consumen los datos dentro de una plataforma moderna.

Tendrás la oportunidad de construir y evolucionar capacidades tecnológicas desde sus bases, definiendo arquitecturas y patrones de integración mediante APIs, Eventos, Microservicios y sistemas distribuidos, y trabajando de forma cercana con Ingeniería, Core Banking, Seguridad y Producto.




¿Qué estamos buscando?




Un perfil senior especializado en Arquitectura e Ingeniería de Datos e Integración, con sólida experiencia en Banca o Servicios Financieros y una fuerte mentalidad de ingeniería.

Buscamos a una persona con dominio de Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Integration Architecture y Data Governance, capaz de conectar las necesidades de negocio y producto con soluciones tecnológicas escalables, resilientes y seguras.

Valoramos especialmente la capacidad para resolver problemas complejos, cuestionar supuestos, definir estándares de arquitectura y tomar decisiones que equilibren velocidad de entrega, escalabilidad, seguridad y sostenibilidad tecnológica.




Retos del Puesto




● Definir la Arquitectura de Datos, modelos, repositorios e infraestructura de la nueva área.

● Diseñar patrones de integración basados en Event-Driven Architecture, Event Streaming, REST APIs, Microservicios y procesamiento Batch.

● Establecer capacidades de Gobierno, Calidad, Consistencia, Privacidad, Linaje y Trazabilidad de Datos.

● Resolver retos de consistencia de datos distribuidos e intercambio de información entre sistemas críticos.

● Habilitar capas de datos confiables para reportería regulatoria, analítica de negocio e Inteligencia Artificial.

● Colaborar con Core Banking, Seguridad, Ingeniería y Producto para garantizar flujos de información seguros, resilientes y escalables.

● Definir patrones tecnológicos y estándares de arquitectura que permitan la evolución de la plataforma a largo plazo.




Requisitos

● Experiencia: 8–10+ años en Arquitectura e Ingeniería de Datos dentro de Banca o Servicios Financieros, con experiencia relevante en arquitecturas de integración y sistemas distribuidos.

● Conocimientos indispensables: Data Architecture, Data Engineering, APIs, Microservicios, Event-Driven Architecture, integración distribuida, Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Privacy y Data Lineage.

● Conocimientos deseables: Event Streaming, Kafka/Confluent, Cloud Data Platforms, Big Data, Data Lake/Lakehouse, BI y Analytics. Se valorará experiencia con AWS, Azure o GCP.

● Escolaridad: Licenciatura en Ingeniería, Ciencias de la Computación, Matemáticas Aplicadas, Sistemas o áreas afines (indispensable). 

Posgrado o certificaciones relacionadas con Big Data, Cloud Data Architectures, Data Engineering o BI serán un plus.

● Idiomas: Inglés avanzado C1, indispensable.




Si has construido o transformado ecosistemas complejos de datos e integración y te motiva la oportunidad de definir capacidades tecnológicas desde sus bases dentro de un entorno bancario de alta exigencia, queremos conocerte.

title: Cofundador
description:
About the job

Cofundador Técnico — Leviathan Network




Descripción de la empresa




Leviathan Network es una plataforma tecnológica diseñada para que los fundadores puedan presentar, desarrollar y hacer crecer sus startups y productos, documentando públicamente su evolución y conectándose con las personas, organizaciones e instituciones que pueden ayudarles a avanzar.




Leviathan abarca el ciclo completo de las startups, desde la presentación y desarrollo de una idea hasta su evolución, crecimiento y consolidación, integrando dentro de un mismo ecosistema el talento, los colaboradores, clientes, usuarios, capital, conocimiento, oportunidades e instituciones que una startup puede necesitar a lo largo de ese proceso.




La plataforma permite que los fundadores no solamente desarrollen sus startups y productos, sino que también documenten públicamente su evolución, generen un historial de lo que están construyendo y encuentren dentro del ecosistema las conexiones y oportunidades que pueden ayudarles a avanzar.




Descripción del puesto




Como Cofundador Técnico de Leviathan Network, la persona seleccionada tendrá la responsabilidad de liderar la evolución tecnológica de la plataforma, con especial enfoque en su escalabilidad, rendimiento, estabilidad y crecimiento.




Se requiere un perfil Full-Stack, capaz de comprender la plataforma de manera integral, participar en el desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades y, al mismo tiempo, identificar y resolver los retos técnicos que surjan conforme aumente su alcance y complejidad.




La responsabilidad principal será llevar la tecnología de Leviathan a una siguiente etapa, fortaleciendo su arquitectura, optimizando su funcionamiento y desarrollando las capacidades necesarias para soportar el crecimiento de la plataforma y del ecosistema.




El puesto contempla participación directa en frontend, backend, bases de datos, APIs, autenticación, integraciones, infraestructura, seguridad, rendimiento y escalabilidad.




También tendrá participación en las decisiones relacionadas con la evolución del producto, evaluando necesidades técnicas, definiendo prioridades y determinando las soluciones necesarias para que Leviathan pueda crecer de manera sólida y sostenible.




Tipo de puesto: Cofundador / Socio

Dedicación: Tiempo completo

Modalidad: A definir




Requisitos




- Experiencia sólida en desarrollo Full-Stack.

- Dominio de desarrollo frontend y backend.

- Experiencia con bases de datos relacionales y/o no relacionales.

- Experiencia en diseño y desarrollo de APIs y servicios backend.

- Conocimiento de arquitectura de software y diseño de sistemas.

- Experiencia con autenticación, autorización y seguridad de aplicaciones.

- Experiencia con infraestructura y servicios en la nube.

- Experiencia en despliegues y entornos de producción.

- Capacidad para identificar problemas de rendimiento, arquitectura y escalabilidad.

- Capacidad para diseñar soluciones orientadas al crecimiento de una plataforma tecnológica.

- Capacidad para trabajar sobre una arquitectura existente y llevarla a una mayor escala.

- Pensamiento orientado a producto.

- Capacidad para tomar decisiones técnicas y establecer prioridades.

- Autonomía, iniciativa y alto sentido de responsabilidad.

- Capacidad para analizar problemas complejos y convertirlos en soluciones técnicas.

- Interés en participar en la evolución de una plataforma tecnológica con visión de largo plazo.




Perfil que requiere Leviathan




La posición requiere una persona técnica que quiera escalar y evolucionar, no solamente programar.




Una persona capaz de analizar una plataforma tecnológica, comprender cómo funciona en conjunto, identificar sus puntos de mejora y tomar las decisiones necesarias para aumentar su capacidad, estabilidad, rendimiento y alcance.




Debe tener criterio técnico para determinar qué debe optimizarse, qué debe evolucionar y qué nuevas capacidades deben incorporarse conforme Leviathan avance hacia nuevas etapas.




Será especialmente valorable la experiencia trabajando con plataformas digitales, SaaS, marketplaces, comunidades tecnológicas o productos con múltiples tipos de usuarios e integraciones.




Más que una lista específica de tecnologías, la posición requiere capacidad técnica, criterio, autonomía y disposición para asumir responsabilidad sobre la evolución tecnológica de Leviathan.




Responsabilidades principales




- Liderar la evolución tecnológica de Leviathan Network.

- Escalar la arquitectura y los componentes de la plataforma.

- Optimizar rendimiento, estabilidad y disponibilidad.

- Desarrollar nuevas funcionalidades y capacidades.

- Evolucionar frontend, backend y bases de datos.

- Diseñar y desarrollar APIs e integraciones.

- Fortalecer infraestructura, seguridad y sistemas de autenticación.

- Identificar cuellos de botella y resolver problemas de escalabilidad.

- Preparar la plataforma para el crecimiento de usuarios, startups, productos y operaciones.

- Evaluar e implementar mejoras tecnológicas que aporten valor al producto.

- Participar en decisiones de arquitectura y evolución del producto.

- Establecer criterios técnicos que permitan que la plataforma continúe creciendo de manera sólida.

- Acompañar la evolución tecnológica de Leviathan conforme aumente su alcance.




Lo que ofrece Leviathan




- 10–20% de equity (participación accionaria en Leviathan Network), determinado de acuerdo con la capacidad técnica, experiencia y nivel de responsabilidad que aporte la persona seleccionada.

- Participación como Cofundador Técnico.

- Participación directa en las decisiones relacionadas con la evolución tecnológica y escalabilidad de la plataforma.

Who We Are & What We Do

At Helix, our mission is simple: to help everyone improve their lives through their DNA. Ready to make a real-world impact with your skills? At Helix, we're transforming healthcare by making genomics a standard of care. We partner with health systems and life science companies to accelerate the integration of genomic data into clinical practice. Join us in building a future where healthcare is personalized, proactive, and powered by genomics.

Your Career Path & Development

We are committed to your long-term growth. We invest in you through:


Cutting-Edge AI Tooling: We equip our engineers to innovate at speed. You'll have full access to GitHub Copilot, frontier models (like Claude and OpenAI), Gemini, and other new tools as they emerge, all supported by our dedicated internal AI team.

What is special about this role?

The Helix Experience Team builds the software platform and user experiences that guide patients and providers through their entire genetics journey, from enrollment through results delivery. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will set the technical direction for this platform and shape engineering standards across the organization.

As a Staff Software Engineer - Experience, You Will


Guide and define the strategic technical direction for the Experience platform and wider Engineering organization.
Shape how Helix Engineering utilizes AI and advance our AI development best practices.
Direct AI agents to automate entire engineering workflows, including codifying our prompt libraries and context frameworks.

Drive complex, ambiguous projects from scoping to production with autonomy, owning the design, architecture and implementation strategy. 
Collaborate and lead cross-functional work with product managers, designers, user experience researchers, scientists, and our business leaders to drive meaningful outcomes to the business.
Shape the engineering standards, delivery practices, and quality bars within all of Engineering.

Champion durable solutions that eliminate entire categories of technical debt and raise reliability.

10+ years of equivalent professional experience as a Software Engineer, with a track record of impact at scale.

Experience designing and architecting event-driven architectures.
Experience with AWS serverless infrastructure.
Experience in the life sciences, healthcare, or genomics domain.


What We Offer: A Commitment to Your Success

We take care of our team with benefits that provide flexibility and support for your growth—what we call prestaciones superiores a las de la ley.

 Initial Screen 2) Technical Interviews 3)Leadership Interviews 4) Final Loop


What To Expect During Your Onboarding Week

We want to make sure your first week is spent learning the foundations. You will be invited to live orientation sessions and spend time with your hiring manager developing your individual roadmap to success. This experience will include sessions that cover your benefits, security & privacy training, an introduction to the OKR framework used at Helix and our communication tools and norms.

What To Expect During Your First 90 Days

First 5 days: You’ll spend time learning the Helix way, completing training and onboarding for your roles, and getting introduced to your team and relevant stakeholders. You’ll also gain a deeper understanding of our customers, our products, the impact we make in the lives of our communities, and how to thrive at Helix through participation in Helix U.

Day 5 - 30: You’ll spend time contributing to projects, deeply familiarizing yourself with team and company processes, and developing a deeper understanding of Helix’s products, services and capabilities.

Day 30 - 90: You’ll build your OKRs with your manager, start to take ownership of projects and initiatives on your team, and begin to demonstrate your impact on the Helix mission.

description:
About the job

ES EL MOMENTO




Santander está evolucionando de ser una marca global de alto impacto a una organización impulsada por la tecnología, y las personas están en el centro de este camino. Juntos, estamos liderando una transformación centrada en el cliente que valora el pensamiento disruptivo, la valentía de desafiar lo posible y la capacidad de innovar.

Esto es más que un cambio estratégico: es una oportunidad para crecer, aprender y generar un impacto real.

Nuestra misión es contribuir a que más personas y empresas prosperen. Adoptamos una sólida cultura de riesgos y esperamos que todos nuestros equipos asuman un enfoque proactivo y responsable en la gestión del riesgo.

Retail & Commercial Banking es un negocio global que integra todas nuestras actividades de banca minorista y comercial para servir mejor a nuestros clientes, mejorar la eficiencia y generar valor.

¿Cómo lo hacemos? Trabajando en equipo, desafiando el negocio, valorando y promoviendo la diversidad y utilizando la tecnología como driver para construir el ecosistema más completo de productos que se adaptan a las necesidades de nuestros clientes.

En Santander trabajamos para crear una plataforma líder de servicios financieros, integrando lo mejor del mundo físico y digital. Somos un banco global con raíces locales, que potencia la tecnología, la innovación y el talento para transformar la experiencia financiera.

Somos Banco Santander México, institución financiera líder que, a través de más de 160 años de reinvención, ha llegado a ser una organización sin fronteras con presencia en más de 40 países, 95 nacionalidades y equipos multiculturales que comparten 4 idiomas.

title: Spanish to English Interpreter
description:
About the job

We’re actively #hiring! Know someone who might be interested?

We are currently hiring Spanish to English Medical Interpreters for a fully remote, full-time Independent Contractor opportunity with i-Call International. The role involves facilitating clear, accurate communication between Spanish-speaking patients and healthcare providers, including doctors, nurses, and other medical professionals.

The selected interpreters will be responsible for accurately interpreting medical terminology, diagnoses, treatments, and healthcare-related information between Spanish and English. The role also involves providing cultural mediation when required, maintaining strict patient confidentiality and professional ethical standards, documenting interpretation services, and staying current with medical terminology and healthcare practices. Candidates will provide both Over-the-Phone Interpretation (OPI) and Video Remote Interpretation (VRI) services.

Candidates must be fluent in Spanish and English, with experience in medical interpretation or translation preferred. Strong knowledge of medical terminology, familiarity with healthcare-related conversations, excellent communication skills, cultural sensitivity, and the ability to work accurately under pressure are essential.

This is a remote position paying $5 per hour, with additional attendance and QA bonuses. Work will follow an hourly shift schedule aligned with the EST time zone, and payments will be made monthly through Payoneer.

Candidates must have a quiet, professional workspace, a minimum 15 Mbps download and upload internet connection, a compulsory USB headset, a PC or laptop with at least a 5th-generation processor and 8GB RAM, LAN/Ethernet connectivity, and an HD webcam.

After accepting the offer, selected candidates will complete a mandatory 80-hour training program over 10 business days. Training is paid at half of the agreed hourly rate, subject to successfully passing the assessment and starting employment. The final assessment will be conducted through LanguageStat, and successful candidates will receive client portal credentials and technical guidance.

Country Eligibility: The client does not accept applicants from the following countries/regions:

European Countries: Albania, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Moldova, the Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, the United States, Canada, Bolivia.

Other Restricted Countries/Regions: China, Iran, Venezuela, Ukraine, Russia, North Korea, Cuba, Afghanistan, Burma, Lebanon, Libya, Somalia, South Sudan, Syria, Yemen, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Armenia, and Turkey.

description:
About the job

PoderJudicialVirtual.com | 100% remoto 




Resumen del rol

Buscamos al ingeniero que se sumará al equipo que va a construir el próximo producto de PoderJudicialVirtual de punta a punta y llevarlo a producción. Es un rol de constructor dentro de un equipo de desarrollo: entre todos toman la especificación, diseñan el backend en Laravel, construyen el frontend en Vue, integran los pagos con Stripe y lo lanzan a miles de usuarios reales. Con ownership real de tu parte del producto, sin capas intermedias y sin nadie revisándote el hombro.

No es un asiento más en una fábrica de software. Estamos ejecutando nuestro plan 2030: pasar de 2 productos en producción a 11 y expandirnos a Sudamérica. Tú construyes el primero de esa nueva ola, y quien construye bien aquí se convierte en pieza central de todo lo que sigue. El crecimiento se gana construyendo, no por antigüedad.

Te integrarás a un equipo de desarrollo en México, de la mano de un líder técnico fuerte, dueño de la arquitectura y la infraestructura, y de un Product Manager Senior que te entrega specs claras con Definition of Ready y Definition of Done. Tú eres dueño del código: de que escale, de que cobre bien y de que llegue a producción sin sorpresas.

Vas a trabajar sobre un dominio complejo (la infraestructura judicial mexicana) que tarda meses en dominarse. No esperamos que llegues sabiéndolo. Sí esperamos que en pocos meses tomes decisiones técnicas independientes y que tu código hable por ti.




Sobre nosotros

PoderJudicialVirtual es una empresa legaltech mexicana con más de 10 años en el mercado. Operamos la plataforma de datos judiciales más grande de México: más de 65 millones de registros de todo el país, con despachos, empresas y miles de personas usando y pagando el servicio todos los días. Somos rentables y no dependemos de inversionistas para ejecutar nuestro plan.




El proyecto

Arranque en septiembre de 2026. El equipo construirá un producto nuevo completo: backend en Laravel, frontend en Vue, flujo de referidos e integración de pagos con Stripe, desde la spec hasta producción. Al lanzarlo, sigue el próximo producto del plan. Aquí no se mantiene lo de otros: se construye lo propio.




Lo que buscamos




Requisitos:

• 5 años o más de experiencia profesional con PHP, idealmente Laravel.

• Capacidad real de leer, entender y mantener código existente con años de historia, no solo arrancar proyectos desde cero.

• MySQL a escala: has trabajado con tablas de millones de registros y sabes de índices y paginación eficiente.

• Vue.js sólido para trabajo full-stack.

• Diseño y consumo de APIs REST que escalan.

• Ownership: tomas un producto y lo llevas a producción. Detectas tus errores antes de entregar.

• Git con flujo profesional: manejo de branches, pull requests y participación activa en code reviews.

• Entorno de desarrollo Linux: configuración autónoma de stack local en Ubuntu (Apache, PHP, MySQL) sin dependencia de soporte externo.




Deseable (suma puntos, no descarta):

• MongoDB, 2 años o más.

• Automatización web: experiencia con Playwright, Puppeteer y gestión de proxies.

• Cloud: familiaridad con servicios de AWS.

• Inglés de lectura técnica: entender documentación, errores y recursos de desarrollo en inglés. No se requiere hablarlo.

• Experiencia integrando pasarelas de pago; Stripe en particular.




Sobre el uso de IA

Usamos IA todos los días y esperamos que tú también. La regla es simple: la IA amplifica tu criterio, no lo sustituye. Debes entender cada línea que mandas a producción. Durante el proceso vas a defender tu código en vivo, sin asistentes: explicar tus decisiones, encontrar errores en código ajeno y modificar comportamiento en tiempo real.




Soft skills (competencias clave que valoramos):

• Criterio técnico en revisión de código. Capacidad para identificar vulnerabilidades, cuellos de botella y errores de lógica, tanto en código propio como en el generado por IA.

Un plan 2030 real, con productos definidos y financiamiento propio, del que tu trabajo es pieza central.

Envía tu CV junto con lo siguiente (las aplicaciones que no incluyan estos puntos no avanzan en el proceso):

Describe un sistema que hayas construido o mantenido tú y que esté (o haya estado) en producción: stack, escala de datos y usuarios, y cuál fue tu responsabilidad concreta.

Tu disponibilidad de inicio.

About the job

Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For

This role is responsible for driving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency by resolving complex, escalated technical issues across our industrial, mobile, and RFID printing portfolios. Utilizing deep hardware and software expertise, the successful candidate will diagnose complex print engine failures, address high-tier calibration challenges, and ensure maximum uptime for critical business environments. Additionally, you will maintain standard-setting response times and proactively contribute to the continuous improvement of the Technical Support Team’s printing diagnostic tools and processes.

Advanced Hardware & Software Troubleshooting


Hardware Maintenance: Expertly diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair print engines, label printers, and mobile printing units to significantly reduce customer downtime.
System Calibration: Configure menus, test sensors, and perform precise printhead adjustments to ensure optimal barcode and RFID readability.
Software Integration: Utilize industry-leading tools, including Zebra Setup Utilities and ZebraDesigner, for seamless device configuration and custom label design.


Customer Success & Escalation Management


Serve as the primary escalation point for resolving highly complex, diverse technical issues that require deep data analysis and critical thinking.
Deliver exceptional technical support to customers via telephone, email, and chat, demonstrating active listening and empathy in high-pressure situations.
Translate highly technical concepts into simple, easy-to-understand terms for both customers and internal management.


Leadership & Process Improvement


Act as a mentor and escalation point to support and guide less experienced agents on the team.
Develop, refine, and improve support processes, tools, and platform developments to enhance the overall customer experience.
Analyze data and prepare detailed reports on the effectiveness and efficiency of the support center.
Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors, internal technical teams, business leaders, and technology partners.


What We Are Looking For


Education: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent vocational qualification/experience in a related technical field.
Experience: 4 to 5 years of proven experience in technical support, with a strong emphasis on hardware maintenance (printing devices, RFID, and mobile technology highly preferred).
Technical Proficiency: Full understanding of job-related procedures and intermediate to advanced skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to provide clear, concise information using proper professional language.
Core Competencies:
Strong customer service orientation with a dedication to resolving issues effectively.
Solid professional work behaviors (attendance, teamwork, time management).
Advanced problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate moderately complex factors.
Intermediate to advanced skills in task delegation and follow-up.

Why Join Us?

We offer a collaborative environment where your technical expertise is valued, and your career growth is supported. Help us keep the world's supply chains, hospitals, and retail floors running smoothly.

Benefits

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

Job Posting Statement

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

AI Technology Statement

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

About the job

About Kueski

At Kueski, we're dedicated to improving the financial lives of people in Mexico. Since 2012, we've been the leading buy now, pay later (BNPL) and online consumer credit platform in Latin America, known for our innovative financial services. Our flagship product, Kueski Pay, provides seamless payment solutions for both online and in-store transactions, establishing itself as the preferred option for nearly 30% of Mexico's top e-commerce merchants. Notably, we were the first to introduce BNPL on Amazon Mexico.

We're a tech company with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration, and impact, fostering a strong, diverse, and inclusive workplace. Our commitment to excellence and ethical business practices has earned us multiple industry recognitions. In 2024, we were named one of the World’s Top FinTech Companies by CNBC and recognized as one of the most ethical companies in Mexico by AMITAI. Additionally, we were certified as a Best Place to Work for LGBTQ+ Equality by HRC Equidad MX 2025 and ranked among the Best Companies for Female Talent by EFY.

Position

We are looking for a Director of Product Management to lead the Customer Products & Platform product area. This team owns Kueski’s customer-facing and partner-embedded experiences, the core product services powering journeys such as onboarding, transactions, and payments, and selected merchant experiences that directly shape the customer journey.

This is a hands-on player-coach role for a leader who combines strong customer and UX judgment, growth thinking, analytical strength, and technical fluency. Reporting to the VP, Head of Product, the Director will serve on Kueski’s Product leadership team, with meaningful authority over product strategy and prioritization and the opportunity to shape the broader Product organization.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy, Outcomes & Growth


Own the strategy, priorities, roadmap, and product decisions for Customer Experience & Platform, aligning with cross-functional leaders on major business, risk, and investment trade-offs.
Establish clear measures of success and improve end-to-end journey performance, including conversion, speed, reliability, engagement, and product quality.
Lead the 1→100 journey—scaling proven products and capabilities into broadly adopted experiences that balance customer outcomes, growth, risk, regulatory obligations, and sustainable economics.


Customer Experience & Product Quality


Simplify complex, high-stakes journeys into intuitive, trusted, and high-quality customer experiences.
Stay close to customer research, behavioral data, and key insights while helping teams build the same customer-centered habits.
Use analytics, experimentation, and AI across discovery, analysis, prototyping, and execution to improve product performance and how teams work.


Cross-Functional Leadership


Partner deeply with Engineering, Design, Data, Growth, Marketing, Risk, Lending, and Finance to deliver shared customer and business outcomes.
Work with Engineering on APIs, architecture, scalability, reliability, delivery quality, and technical investment trade-offs.
Create alignment around priorities, decision rights, and execution plans while communicating recommendations and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders.


Team & Organizational Leadership


Lead, coach, and develop Product Managers and senior individual contributors, going deep with teams on critical journeys and decisions.
Build a scalable management layer by developing internal leaders and hiring where needed.
Raise the quality of product thinking and establish operating practices that help teams execute with accountability, focus, and speed.


Job Requirements


8+ years of Product Management experience, with demonstrated Director-level scope leading complex product areas and multi-level Product teams.
Proven success scaling customer-facing products from early traction to broad adoption across owned web or mobile products and partner-embedded channels.
Experience managing both Product leaders and senior individual contributors, including developing leaders, hiring, coaching, and holding teams accountable for outcomes.
A strong track record of simplifying complex, high-stakes journeys into intuitive, trusted products in close partnership with Product Design.
Experience delivering measurable improvements in activation, conversion, adoption, engagement, retention, revenue, or other business outcomes.
Strong analytical judgment, including defining metrics, interrogating analyses, evaluating experiments, and making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty.
Strong technical fluency, with the ability to reason about APIs, data flows, architecture, reliability, and technical trade-offs without needing to write production code.
Demonstrated ability to use AI meaningfully in product work and help teams adopt AI-enabled ways of working.
Experience building products in fintech or another regulated consumer industry is strongly preferred.
Professional fluency in both English and Spanish is required.

description:
About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.




Your New Role:
The Business Analyst is responsible for the planning and execution throughout the lifecycle of one or more software solutions within the business domain. This includes creating and prioritizing product and business requirements and working closely with business and technology teams to ensure business stakeholder and end user satisfaction goals are met. He or she will create and develop requirements and concepts for product enhancements in support of business and technology needs. This position provides a wide variety of services to our business users including business analysis and quality assurance, in support of strategic and tactical planning of systems features / functionality as well as day to day business operations. The role also entails Project Management for software releases and managing of SOX processes and documentation.




Your Role Accountabilities:




Business Analysis

Collaborate with key business stakeholders to generate business requirements based on use cases/user stories. Prioritize and scope based on business input and ROI. 
Lead collaboration with the global teams to assure incorporation of global requirements for enhancements when prioritized and justified related to regional requirements. Assure no negative impact to global regional workflows.
Collaborate with internal engineering, vendor engineering, internal technical teams and external technical teams to assure vendor and technical designs cover mandatory business requirements.
Serve as primary contact for the business for the support of system functionality, business process and workflow and react to emerging or changing revenue opportunities and industry trends.
Lead proof-of-concept priority projects related to new or adjusted business processes to satisfy industry or business adjustments. 
Participate in assessment and feasibility studies of available technologies and recommend solutions.
Manage business and functional requirements for one or more business solutions related to Content Rights, Scheduling, Traffic, Presentation and Reconciliation operations.
Manage relationships with multiple business organizations, global technology groups and 3rd party software vendors including: facilitating requirement and design workshops, reviewing designs, test plans and test cases; reviewing vendor deliverables and schedules; managing quality or delivery issues with the vendor; coordinating end user testing and sign-off for in-house and vendor deliverables.

Functional Testing

Perform functional testing and document workflow and configuration changes related to system and process adjustments based on Proof-of-concept outcomes or business requirements.

Training

Provide a walk thorough of new functionality including both system functionality and region-specific recommended configuration and workflow. Train the trainer.
Assist in the design, delivery, and improvement of in-house training programs and related courseware.

Compliance and Standards

Ensure compliance with Warner Bros. Discovery Software Development Lifecycle documentation and mandated compliance requirements for all application changes.

General

Work independently under minimal supervision.




Qualifications & Experiences:

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent degree/work experience
Experience supporting technology solutions in a Media industry organization
Minimum of 3 years’ experience with mid to large-scale software development projects – understanding all phases of systems development
Strong prioritization and organization skills
Strong presentation and communication skills; excellent listening skills, ability to interface with business customers at all levels of the organization
Strong project management skills
Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
Excellent people skills – negotiation, conflict resolution, providing direction and focus
Ability to work on multiple projects at one time with minimal supervision and to ensure that overall priorities are being met
Proven ability to successfully operate within, and contribute to, a high growth, entrepreneurial, fast paced business and matrix environment.

Preferred qualifications

Experience in Air-Time Sales, Business Intelligence, and Audience Research business areas and respective applications desirable
Formal Business Analysis Training desirable
Experience with AI enabled application business design and usage a plus.




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, union status, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

Samsonite es una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a promover y mantener un entorno de trabajo en el que todos los solicitantes, asociados, clientes y otras personas sean tratados con dignidad y respeto, libres de acoso, discriminación o represalias.
