description:
About the job

Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $1,160,000 - $1,510,000 MXN + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $1,160,000 - $1,317,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of — together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.


Client: Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.


People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.


Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals.
Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward. 


Qualifications


You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across multiple platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).
You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles.
You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs.
You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization.
You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives.
You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

Cultura vibrante. Estamos comprometidos con una cultura diversa y rica, que acoge a personas de todas las profesiones y condiciones sociales. Nuestro compromiso de larga data con la diversidad y la inclusión nos permite aportar cada día al trabajo nuestro auténtico yo y nuestras diferencias únicas.

Socialmente responsables.  Queremos minimizar el impacto de nuestros productos en el medio ambiente y ayudar a crear viajes positivos en todo el mundo. Para ello, creamos los mejores productos utilizando los materiales, métodos y modelos más sostenibles e innovadores.

Lo Que Valoramos

En Samsonite, hacemos más que crear las maletas que se mueven con nuestros clientes, inspiramos y celebramos los momentos que les mueven. Creemos que tenemos una responsabilidad con el mundo en cómo operamos, los productos que vendemos, las comunidades donde vivimos y trabajamos, y cómo tratamos a las personas que trabajan con nosotros. Somos tan diversos como los viajes mismos, y como los viajes, tu viaje con Samsonite presenta la oportunidad de formar parte de algo más grande y explorar tus pasiones. Por eso ofrecemos varios caminos para los profesionales y celebramos los conocimientos y habilidades que aportan a nuestro equipo. Estamos comprometidos con un lugar de trabajo respetuoso que permita a los miembros de nuestro equipo aportar diariamente lo mejor de sí mismos.

Samsonite es una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a promover y mantener un entorno de trabajo en el que todos los solicitantes, asociados, clientes y otras personas sean tratados con dignidad y respeto, libres de acoso, discriminación o represalias.

To address these strategic business aims, the role focuses on three core areas: digital demand management, strategic IT-business partnering for switchgear manufacturing plants, and team leadership of IT business systems analysts. Given the focus on manufacturing operations digitalization, the ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in industrial IT/OT environments, proven team leadership capabilities, and strong stakeholder management skills within a multinational matrix organization.

40% Digital Strategy & Demand Management

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. About the job

About The Role

The Enterprise Marketing team builds demand for Shopify among the most iconic brands in the world.

We’re looking for a senior individual contributor to drive the technical design and hands-on optimization of Shopify’s Enterprise demand engine. This is an advanced individual contributor role for someone with deep ABM expertise, strong analytical judgment, and the technical ability to build. You’ll independently evaluate account, buying-committee, funnel, and opportunity data, determine the right program response, and execute those programs in partnership with GTM teams.

You’ll work across the full Enterprise funnel, from customer acquisition to opportunity acceleration, and account expansion. The work is account-based, signal-driven, and built around the realities of complex enterprise buying cycles.

You’ll also help build an AI-native operating model for Enterprise demand. AI is not a separate work stream. It should change how we research accounts, interpret signals, design programs, personalize experiences, equip sellers, run experiments, and automate processes.

Key Responsibilities:


Analyze the Enterprise funnel at the territory, account and opportunity level. Find where conversion, progression, velocity, buying-committee coverage, and seller activation break down. Translate those insights into a clear POV on where and why marketing should invest
Evolve our measurement model to connect marketing activity to account engagement, Sales Accepted Leads, opportunity movement, pipeline, revenue, and return on investment.
Design and execute 1:1, 1:few, and scaled ABM programs for strategic accounts and account clusters.
Build integrated programs across paid media, digital experiences, content, outbound, executive engagement, events, direct mail, and seller-led activation.
Design programs as measurable experiments with a clear hypothesis, baseline, audience, intervention, and decision criteria. Instrument the work, separate commercial movement from attribution noise, then scale, change, or stop based on what the evidence shows.
Work directly with Sales and Partnerships on account strategy so Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships operate as one motion.
Build AI into how Enterprise demand operates, using agents, models, and automation to analyze account and funnel data, synthesize intelligence, map buying committees, activate signals, personalize programs, and recommend next actions.



Qualifications


Strong track record of building enterprise demand and ABM programs that hit pipeline and revenue targets in B2B SaaS, ecommerce, or technology
Deep evidence of successfully running 1:1, 1:few, and scaled ABM programs and Sales plays that created and accelerated pipeline.
Advanced funnel analysis and program measurement skills to clearly articulate ROI, along with the ability to communicate insights clearly across stakeholder groups
Hands-on fluency across CRM, marketing automation, intent, enrichment, advertising, orchestration, data warehouses, and business intelligence systems, including the ability to query and investigate data directly.
Credibility with Sales stakeholders built through deep account insight, clear judgment, focused execution, and a ‘win together’ attitude.
The ability to lead complex cross-functional work without requiring formal authority
A history of building AI agents, workflows, or automations that materially improved how enterprise demand programs were designed, executed, or measured. You’ve lived on the edge of what’s possible with AI.



About Shopify

Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to over 8,300 employees and generated over $1 trillion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.

This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.

Before you apply, consider if you can:


Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)

Bring critical thought and opinion

Work digital-first for your daily work

You will help leadership understand the key drivers of business performance across multiple markets and transform complex data into actionable recommendations.




What You'll Be Doing

✅ Analyze market performance across states and regions to identify growth opportunities and operational challenges.

✅ Evaluate supply-and-demand dynamics, including provider capacity, patient demand, appointment availability, utilization, and geography.

✅ Investigate conversion funnels and booking performance to identify friction points impacting patient acquisition.

✅ Conduct root-cause analyses to determine what is truly driving business outcomes.

✅ Apply statistical methods, forecasting, segmentation, and hypothesis-driven analysis to solve complex business problems.

✅ Partner with Marketing, Product, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership to influence strategic decisions.

✅ Help determine where the company should invest, expand, optimize, or scale back based on data-driven insights.




What We're Looking For

✔️ 6+ years of experience in Growth Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Revenue Operations, Market Intelligence, or a similar analytical function.

✔️ Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.

✔️ Expert-level Looker experience, including building dashboards, Explores, custom fields, and Looks.

✔️ Experience in healthcare, healthcare services, marketplaces, retail, multi-location businesses, or other supply-and-demand-driven environments.

✔️ Strong experience identifying the root causes behind business performance changes and translating findings into recommendations.

✔️ Ability to operate independently, build your own analytical roadmap, and influence senior stakeholders.

✔️ Experience with Python, R, forecasting, predictive analytics, experimentation, or RevOps is a strong plus.




Success in This Role Looks Like

You can confidently explain:

Why a market is outperforming or underperforming.
Whether the issue is demand, capacity, utilization, conversion, geography, or a combination of factors.
Which variables matter most.
What actions leadership should take next.
The expected impact of those actions.

📍 Remote

🕒 Must be able to work with EST business hours

About the job

Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.




The Content Integrity Editor works closely with the fact-checking and copyediting teams within the Content Integrity Group (CIG) to uphold Condé Nast’s editorial standards by ensuring the accuracy, consistency, clarity, and integrity of digital and print content across its English-language publications. Based in the Mexico network hub, this role works under the supervision of senior team members and in coordination with fact-checkers, copy editors, legal affairs editors, and global workflow leadership.




The Content Integrity Editor ensures that published material is thoroughly vetted for factual accuracy and style consistency, aligned with Condé Nast’s editorial and ethical standards, and appropriate for its intended audience.
